intro_text.en: Start with a practical situation,draw the model,and solve one step at a time.
intro_text.gu: Practical પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂ કરીએ,model દોરીએ અને એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલીએ.

body.en:
Start with a situation

A part may be hard but brittle, or strong but too heavy. Material selection needs both properties and a valid test method.

Definition

This unit is marked for laboratory coverage in the supplied syllabus; no separate theory hours are assigned. It still has an8% course-content weight entry.

Understand the reason

Study what each test measures, which specimen/setup is used, how results are interpreted and which limitations apply. No actual test completion is claimed here.

Example / application

An impact test compares energy absorbed in a specified notched specimen; it is not a direct universal service-life prediction.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Use trained supervision, guards and the relevant standard; these notes are learning guidance, not permission to operate a testing machine.
body.gu:
એક પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત કરીએ

Part hard પણ brittle હોઈ શકે,strong પણ વધારે ભારે હોય.Material selectionમાં properties અને valid test method બન્ને જોઈએ.

ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Supplied syllabusમાં આ unit laboratoryમાં cover કરવાનો છે;અલગ theory hours આપેલા નથી.તેમ છતાં course-content weight entry8% છે.

હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

દરેક test શું માપે,કયો specimen/setup છે,resultનો અર્થ અને limitations સમજો.અહીં actual test completionનો દાવો નથી.

ઉદાહરણ / ઉપયોગ

Impact test specified notched specimenની absorbed energy સરખાવે;સીધી universal service-life prediction નહિ.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Trained supervision,guards,relevant standard લો;આ learning guidance છે,testing machine ચલાવવાની permission નહિ.

body.en:
Definition

Metals/alloys include ferrous(iron-based:steels, cast irons) and nonferrous(aluminium, copper, titanium alloys).Polymers include thermoplastics, thermosets and elastomers.

Ceramics/glasses offer characteristic hardness/thermal/corrosion behaviour but often limited tensile ductility. Composites combine constituents to obtain useful directional or multifunctional behaviour.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Family names do not establish a grade-specific allowable stress, temperature limit or corrosion resistance; consult qualified material data and service requirements.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Metals/alloysમાં ferrous(iron-based:steels,cast irons),nonferrous(aluminium,copper,titanium alloys) આવે.Polymersમાં thermoplastics,thermosets,elastomers આવે.

Ceramics/glassesમાં characteristic hardness/thermal/corrosion behaviour,પણ ઘણીવાર limited tensile ductility હોય.Composites constituents જોડીને directional/multifunctional behaviour આપે.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Family nameથી grade-specific allowable stress,temperature limit,corrosion resistance નક્કી નથી થતા;qualified data,service requirements જોઈએ.

h.en: 8.1.3 Elasticity, plasticity, ductility, malleability and brittleness

body.en:
Definition

Elasticity:recoverable deformation. Plasticity:permanent deformation after unloading. Ductility:capacity for plastic deformation in tension, commonly assessed by elongation/reduction in area.

Malleability:capacity for plastic shaping under compression, such as rolling/hammering into sheets. Brittleness:fracture with little plastic deformation under the stated conditions.

Example / application

A material suited to wire drawing needs ductility; sheet forming emphasises malleability/formability. Behaviour varies with temperature, strain rate, heat treatment and defects.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Elastic modulus measures stiffness, not the maximum strength or the amount of ductility.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Elasticity:recoverable deformation.Plasticity:unloading પછી permanent deformation.Ductility:tensionમાં plastic deformationની ક્ષમતા,સામાન્ય રીતે elongation/reduction in areaથી તપાસીએ.

Malleability:compressionથી plastic shapingની ક્ષમતા,જેમ rolling/hammeringથી sheets.Brittleness:stated conditionsમાં ઓછી plastic deformation સાથે fracture.

ઉદાહરણ / ઉપયોગ

Wire drawingમાં ductility જોઈએ;sheet formingમાં malleability/formability મહત્વની.Behaviour temperature,strain rate,heat treatment,defectsથી બદલાય.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Elastic modulus stiffness બતાવે,maximum strength કે ductilityની માત્રા નહિ.

body.en:
Definition

Toughness is the capacity to absorb energy before fracture under defined conditions. Hardness is resistance to a defined indentation/scratch/local deformation method; different scales are not automatically interchangeable.

Fatigue is damage/failure under repeated or fluctuating loading; it can occur below a static yield stress. Creep is time-dependent deformation under sustained stress, important at suitable temperature/material conditions.

Remember / avoid this mistake

High hardness does not guarantee high toughness, and high static tensile strength alone does not guarantee fatigue/creep life.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Toughness defined conditionsમાં fracture પહેલાં energy absorb કરવાની ક્ષમતા છે.Hardness defined indentation/scratch/local deformationનો resistance છે;જુદા scales આપમેળે interchangeable નથી.

Fatigue repeated/fluctuating loadથી damage/failure છે;static yield stressથી નીચે પણ થઈ શકે.Creep sustained stressમાં time-dependent deformation છે,યોગ્ય temperature/material conditionsમાં મહત્વનું.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

High hardness એટલે high toughnessની guarantee નહિ;high static tensile strengthથી એકલી fatigue/creep life guarantee નહિ.

body.en:
Definition

A pendulum fractures a specified notched cantilever specimen; loss of pendulum energy gives absorbed impact energy after required corrections.

Construction:parts and purpose

A rigid pendulum frame and calibrated release/angle system establish available energy.

A vice clamps the specimen vertically as a cantilever.

A specified notch and striker geometry define the impact configuration.

Energy indicator, guards and interlocks support controlled testing.

Working:sequence and reason

Under trained supervision, verify standard, specimen dimensions/notch, temperature and machine status.

Clamp in the specified orientation; in the usual Izod arrangement the notch faces the striker.

Use approved guarded release and let the pendulum strike the specimen.

Read corrected energy and report test method, temperature, specimen and fracture observations.

Remember / avoid this mistake

The impact is above the clamped/notched region as specified; do not copy Charpy support orientation. Energy depends on specimen and notch geometry.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Pendulum specified notched cantilever specimen તોડે;જરૂરી corrections પછી pendulum energy loss absorbed impact energy આપે.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

Rigid pendulum frame,calibrated release/angle system available energy આપે.

Vice specimenને vertical cantilever તરીકે clamp કરે.

Specified notch,striker geometry impact configuration આપે.

Energy indicator,guards,interlocks controlled testing આપે.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

Trained supervisionમાં standard,specimen dimensions/notch,temperature,machine status તપાસો.

Specified orientationમાં clamp કરો;usual Izodમાં notch striker તરફ હોય.

Approved guarded releaseથી pendulum strike થવા દો.

Corrected energy વાંચી method,temperature,specimen,fracture observations report કરો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Impact specified રીતે clamped/notched region ઉપર છે;Charpy support orientation copy ન કરો.Energy specimen,notch geometry પર આધારિત છે.

body.en:
Definition

A pendulum strikes a notched specimen supported horizontally as a simple beam.

Construction:parts and purpose

A calibrated pendulum supplies the impact energy.

Two anvils support the horizontal specimen at the specified span.

The notch, striker radius and support geometry follow the selected standard.

Guarding/interlocks and an energy indicator complete the machine.

Working:sequence and reason

Check standard, specimen/notch, temperature, span and machine calibration under supervision.

Place the notch opposite the striker in the usual Charpy arrangement.

Conduct the impact only through the authorised guarded procedure.

Record corrected absorbed energy and required specimen/fracture details.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Izod and Charpy results are method/specimen dependent; do not compare their rawJ as identical properties or invent a universal conversion.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Pendulum horizontal simply supported notched specimenને strike કરે.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

Calibrated pendulum impact energy આપે.

બે anvils horizontal specimenને specified span પર ટેકો આપે.

Notch,striker radius,support geometry selected standard મુજબ છે.

Guarding/interlocks,energy indicator machine પૂરું કરે.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

Supervisionમાં standard,specimen/notch,temperature,span,machine calibration જુઓ.

Usual Charpyમાં notch strikerની opposite બાજુ રાખો.

Authorised guarded procedureથી જ impact કરો.

Corrected absorbed energy,જરૂરી specimen/fracture details નોંધો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Izod,Charpy results method/specimen dependent છે;raw Jને એક જ property માની સરખાવો નહિ,universal conversion ન બનાવો.

body.en:
Given

Illustrative pendulum potential-energy drop from release to rebound is120 J; validated machine-loss correction5 J.

Stepwise solution

  1. Absorbed specimen energy=120−5=115 J
  2. If a specified legacy/course impact-strength convention divides by net ligament area80 mm², value=115/80=1.4375 J/mm².

Remember / avoid this mistake

Modern reporting often specifies absorbed energy inJ with exact specimen/standard; normalising by area is not a universal interchangeable fracture property.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Illustrative pendulum releaseથી rebound potential-energy drop120J;validated machine-loss correction5J.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. Absorbed specimen energy=120−5=115J
  2. Specified legacy/course impact-strength conventionમાં net ligament area80mm²થી divide કરીએ તો value=115/80=1.4375J/mm².

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Modern reportingમાં ઘણીવાર exact specimen/standard સાથે absorbed energy Jમાં આપે;areaથી normalise કરેલું universal interchangeable fracture property નથી.

body.en:
Definition

A specified hard ball is pressed into a surface; hardness is calculated from force and the curved indentation area determined by measured diameter.

Construction:parts and purpose

A hard ball indenter has diameterD.

A controlled test-force mechanism appliesF for a specified dwell.

A rigid support/anvil holds a prepared specimen.

An optical system measures indentation diameters.

Working:sequence and reason

Select the specified ball, force, dwell and appropriate specimen thickness/spacing.

Prepare/support the test surface and verify the machine with reference blocks.

Apply and remove force by the supervised test procedure.

Measure diameters in required directions and calculate/report HBW with the test designation.

Remember / avoid this mistake

WithF inN andD, d inmm:HBW=.102×2F/[pi D(D−sqrt(D²−d²))].The.102 factor corresponds to the conventional hardness-number force convention; do not omit it with force inN.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Specified hard ball surfaceમાં દબાવીએ;force અને measured diameterથી મળતા curved indentation area વડે hardness ગણીએ.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

Hard ball indenterનો diameter D છે.

Controlled mechanism specified dwell માટે F આપે.

Rigid support/anvil prepared specimen પકડે.

Optical system indentation diameters માપે.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

Specified ball,force,dwell,યોગ્ય thickness/spacing લો.

Surface prepare/support કરી reference blocksથી machine verify કરો.

Supervised test procedureથી force આપો/કાઢો.

જરૂરી directionsમાં diameters માપી HBW,test designation report કરો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

F Nમાં,D,d mmમાં:HBW=.102×2F/[pi D(D−sqrt(D²−d²))].આ.102 conventional hardness-number force convention માટે છે;F Nમાં હોય ત્યારે છોડશો નહિ.

body.en:
Given

D10 mm, F29430 N, mean indentationd4 mm; use the stated.102 conventional factor.

Stepwise solution

  1. sqrt(D²−d²)=sqrt(100−16)=9.165151 mm
  2. HBW=.102×(2×29430)/[pi×10×(10−9.165151)]≈228.91

Remember / avoid this mistake

Report the complete specified HBW designation including ball/force/dwell as required; do not call every result “HB” without test conditions.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

D10mm,F29430N,mean indentation d4mm;આપેલો.102 conventional factor લો.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. sqrt(D²−d²)=sqrt(100−16)=9.165151mm
  2. HBW=.102×(2×29430)/[pi×10×(10−9.165151)]≈228.91

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Required ball/force/dwell સહિત complete specified HBW designation આપો;conditions વગર બધાને “HB” ન કહો.

body.en:
Definition

Rockwell evaluates permanent indentation-depth increase under a defined preliminary and additional test-force cycle.

Construction:parts and purpose

A scale-specific indenter is a diamond cone or specified hard ball.

Preliminary and additional-force systems establish the required cycle.

A depth-sensing system reads the change relative to the preliminary reference.

An anvil, suitable specimen support and scale display complete the system.

Working:sequence and reason

Choose the appropriate scale/indenter/force for material and thickness.

Check reference blocks, surface condition and spacing under the governing standard.

Apply preliminary force and establish the reference depth.

Apply additional force, dwell, then return to preliminary force and measure permanent depth increase.

Report the scale-specific result, e.g. HRC orHRB, not a unitless unlabelled “Rockwell” number.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Common regular scales use98.07 N preliminary force and total forces depending on the scale; superficial scales differ. Always follow the exact scale specification rather than one universal load.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Rockwell defined preliminary,additional test-force cycleમાં permanent indentation-depth increase માપે.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

Scale-specific indenter diamond cone કે specified hard ball છે.

Preliminary,additional-force systems required cycle આપે.

Depth-sensing system preliminary reference સામે change વાંચે.

Anvil,યોગ્ય specimen support,scale display system પૂરું કરે.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

Material,thickness માટે યોગ્ય scale/indenter/force લો.

Governing standardથી reference blocks,surface condition,spacing જુઓ.

Preliminary force આપી reference depth લો.

Additional force,dwell પછી preliminary force પર આવી permanent depth increase માપો.

Scale-specific result જેમ HRC,HRB આપો;બિનlabelled “Rockwell” number નહિ.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Common regular scalesમાં preliminary98.07N,total force scale પ્રમાણે;superficial scales જુદા છે.Universal load નહિ,exact scale specification લો.

h.en: 8.1.11 Compression and tensile tests in the practical list
h.gu: 8.1.11 Practical Listના Compression અને Tensile Tests

body.en:
Understand the reason

The supplied list also includes mild-steel tension(Unit4) and compression of cast iron, mild steel and wood parallel/perpendicular to grain. Use a suitable UTM, correct platens/grips, alignment and approved specimen procedure.

Compression testing records load/deformation and failure behaviour. Strength criteria depend on material/method; ductile compression specimens may barrel rather than fracture sharply, and wood is direction/moisture dependent.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Specimen preparation, load rating, guarded operation and test reporting need qualified supervision. No fabricated observations or calibration certificates are supplied.
body.gu:
હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Supplied listમાં mild-steel tension(Unit4),cast iron,mild steel,woodના grainને parallel/perpendicular compression પણ છે.યોગ્ય UTM,platens/grips,alignment,approved specimen procedure જોઈએ.

Compressionમાં load/deformation,failure behaviour નોંધીએ.Strength criterion material/method પર આધારિત;ductile specimen sharp fractureને બદલે barrel થઈ શકે;wood direction/moisture dependent છે.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Specimen preparation,load rating,guarded operation,reporting માટે qualified supervision જોઈએ.બનાવટી observations કે calibration certificates આપેલા નથી.

body.en:
Build an exam answer

  1. State function, load type, temperature, corrosion, wear, fatigue/creep requirements, manufacturability, cost, availability, repairability and environmental impact; compare suitable grades with evidence.
  2. For a test answer/report include aim, principle, labelled setup, standard/specimen, supervised procedure, actual observations, calculation, result with conditions, limitations and safety.

Remember / avoid this mistake

An observation table may be prepared blank, but fill it only with genuinely measured values; label worked examples as illustrative.

Quick check: Does the highest hardness mean the best lifting hook?

No. The hook also needs suitable toughness, ductility, strength, fatigue performance and certified design/material requirements.
body.gu:
પરીક્ષામાં જવાબ ગોઠવીએ

  1. Function,load type,temperature,corrosion,wear,fatigue/creep,manufacturability,cost,availability,repairability,environmental impact લખો;evidenceથી suitable grades સરખાવો.
  2. Test answer/reportમાં aim,principle,labelled setup,standard/specimen,supervised procedure,actual observations,calculation,conditions સાથે result,limitations,safety આપો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Observation table blank તૈયાર કરી શકાય,પણ ફક્ત ખરેખર measured values ભરો;worked examplesને illustrative label કરો.

જાતે વિચારો: Highest Hardness એટલે Best Lifting Hook?

ના.Hookને toughness,ductility,strength,fatigue performance,certified design/material requirements પણ જોઈએ.
